actions.action: Separate reservation requests from inspected-stock commitments
actions.mechanism: Expected returns support tentative requests, not pickup promises; only inspected, uncommitted items support ready-for-pickup status.
actions.implementation: Track each item's inspection, condition, accessories, and allocation. Atomically allocate inspected stock before confirming readiness; require consent before changing the reserved item.
actions.check: Simulate concurrent reservations and late returns. No item receives overlapping commitments, and no uninspected item supports a readiness confirmation.
actions.risk: Tentative status must be conspicuous during booking and afterward.

actions.action: Open recovery cases automatically when returns slip
actions.mechanism: A missed return deadline creates owned, time-bounded recovery work for every dependent reservation.
actions.implementation: Link reservations to expected returns. On lateness, create cases with an owner, pickup deadline, and branches for consented substitution, borrower-approved rescheduling, or recorded unfulfilled pickup.
actions.check: Inject a late return affecting several bookings. Every affected booking gets a case; none closes without a recorded outcome.
actions.risk: Notification alone must not count as completed recovery.

actions.action: Offer substitutions with explicit differences and consent
actions.mechanism: Borrowers approve the actual replacement, including its condition and accessories, rather than a generic equivalence claim.
actions.implementation: Offer inspected, uncommitted alternatives through the supplied contact preference. List differences, place an expiring hold, and record affirmative consent before allocation.
actions.check: Test refusal, silence, expired holds, and changed accessories. None results in substitution without valid consent for the offered configuration.
actions.risk: Long holds can obstruct recovery for other borrowers.

actions.action: Reserve operational time between return and pickup
actions.mechanism: Scheduling gaps provide time for inspection and recovery without treating expected returns as inspected inventory.
actions.implementation: Configure turnaround intervals from recorded inspection durations and opening hours. Reject impossible handoffs; label future-return-dependent requests tentative and retain their original requested pickup windows.
actions.check: Replay actual timelines with proposed intervals. Report feasible handoffs, failed pickups, and requests displaced by the scheduling rule.
actions.risk: Excessive gaps reduce access without necessarily preventing lateness.

actions.action: Prioritize inspections by threatened pickup deadlines
actions.mechanism: Returned items blocking imminent reservations enter an urgent inspection queue, while safety requirements remain unchanged.
actions.implementation: Keep returns unavailable pending inspection. Sort inspection work by dependent pickup deadline; use aging to prevent starvation and record condition and accessories before release.
actions.check: Introduce an inspection backlog. Verify urgent items are surfaced, older work progresses, and incomplete or failed inspections never release stock.
actions.risk: Deadline pressure must not shorten required safety checks.

actions.action: Check reservation conflicts before granting extensions
actions.mechanism: Extension decisions expose downstream conflicts before an administrative change makes another reservation impossible.
actions.implementation: Evaluate extension requests against dependent pickup windows and inspection time. Block automatic approval on conflict, preserve original deadlines, and open recovery work if continued possession threatens pickup.
actions.check: Request an extension across a dependent booking. The system flags the conflict and never silently shifts that borrower's pickup.
actions.risk: Declining an extension cannot ensure the item's physical return.

actions.action: Gate recovery communication by existing contact preferences
actions.mechanism: A centralized dispatch rule prevents urgent recovery work from bypassing each borrower's permitted contact route.
actions.implementation: Route reminders, substitution offers, and status changes only through the supplied preference. Record delivery failures; queue staff follow-up through that same route without collecting new contact details.
actions.check: Test incompatible channels, failed delivery, and unanswered offers. No alternate-channel message or inferred consent occurs.
actions.risk: An unreachable borrower may remain unrecovered before pickup.

actions.action: Measure failures against original booking intent
actions.mechanism: Immutable booking cohorts prevent cancellations and rescheduling from disguising unsupported or missed pickup commitments.
actions.implementation: Retain original windows and outcomes, including library-induced cancellations. Audit preventability against timestamped stock, inspection, consent, and recovery records; report tentative requests and confirmed pickups separately.
actions.check: Cancel or move a difficult booking in test data. Its original-window miss remains counted; preventability requires evidence of a feasible timely intervention.
actions.risk: Preventability judgments need documented rules and periodic review.
